name: Filter rayvn entries
info: Filters Rayvn log entries to only include new entries. Removes entries older than the last sync timestamp and excludes entries with WaSOS label to prevent duplicates.

name: Filter by time
info: Filters entries by timestamp. Only keeps entries newer than lastRayvnEntryTimeStamp to avoid reprocessing old data.

name: filter by label
info: Filters out entries with WaSOS label. These entries originated from WaSOS and should not be sent back to prevent infinite loops.

name: stop empty injects
info: stops and output from this subflow if empty or null
